title: Import reconciliation E: G1 final challenge, release cleanup and decision recovery
outcome: TermAl answers a core final-apply challenge only from a prepared, durably persisted fence with a complete settled inventory. It reconciles the exact terminal apply or abandon decision across crashes and boot, with one winner and no partial graph.
acceptance: Tests: the same hold on two required hosts with one dead stays pending; a stale, missing, duplicate or foreign attestation cannot fill a slot; a changed inventory, candidate, claim or read-set rejects the apply; owner release triggers cleanup and blocks final Ready until it settles; a host crash before persistence, after Ready, or before or after the core commit restores the fence and reconciles exactly; concurrent apply and abandon have one winner; a failed apply leaves no partial graph and a cancellation revives no claim. A successful whole sequence yields one import receipt and zero new provider sends while held. There is no asynchronous invalidation-only design (no TOCTOU).
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
